title: Unify the behavior between two way to bind server.

timeline.message: unify the behavior between two way to bind server.
timeline.author: horizonzy

timeline.body:
Motivation:

Explain here the context, and why you're making that change.
Unify the behavior between two way to bind server.

Fixes #11013
I think this is not correct... as its not a "builder" method which means it shouldn't change the bootstrap itself. @chrisvest thoughts ?

reply.body: I agree. The parameter is more like an override of a default. Those who want to know what address was bound in the end, will have to get the address via the ChannelFuture.
Just reserve bind() without param will be more reasonable. But due to history issue, it can't be remove easily.
So I think we should just close this as "won't fix"... @chrisvest agree ?
For the address binding, yes. It still makes sense to have the exceptions unified in master, if they aren't already.
reopen a pr to unify the exception message?
